contribution_types.label: UNKNOWN: no contribution-type taxonomy published for ICLR 2027
contribution_types.scope: ICLR 2027 publishes subject areas but no official contribution-type categories.
contribution_types.quote: We consider a broad range of subject areas including feature learning, metric learning, compositional modeling, structured prediction, reinforcement learning, uncertainty quantification and issues regarding large-scale learning and non-convex optimization, as well as applications in vision, audio, speech, language, music, robotics, games, healthcare, biology, sustainability, economics, ethical considerations in ML, and others.

review_criteria.name: Problem Scope
review_criteria.official_explanation: What specific question or problem the paper tackles.
review_criteria.quote: What is the specific question and/or problem tackled by the paper?

review_criteria.name: Motivation and Placement
review_criteria.official_explanation: Whether the approach is well motivated and well placed in the literature.
review_criteria.quote: Is the approach well motivated, including being well-placed in the literature?

review_criteria.name: Claims Support
review_criteria.official_explanation: Whether theoretical or empirical results supporting the claims are correct and scientifically rigorous.
review_criteria.quote: Does the paper support the claims?

review_criteria.name: Significance
review_criteria.official_explanation: Whether the work contributes new knowledge and sufficient value to the community.
review_criteria.quote: What is the significance of the work?

review_criteria.name: Novel Findings
review_criteria.official_explanation: Novel findings, whether theoretical, algorithmic or empirical.
review_criteria.quote: Strong points: is the submission clear, technically correct, experimentally rigorous, reproducible, does it present novel findings

review_criteria.name: Reproducibility
review_criteria.official_explanation: It is important that published ICLR work is reproducible; a reproducibility statement is recommended.
review_criteria.quote: It is important that the work published in ICLR is reproducible.

review_criteria.name: Code of Ethics Compliance
review_criteria.official_explanation: Reviewers raise potential violations of the ICLR Code of Ethics.
review_criteria.quote: reviewers are asked to raise potential violations of the ICLR Code of Ethics.

review_criteria.name: Anonymity Compliance
review_criteria.official_explanation: Revealing author identity in the main text or supplementary material leads to desk rejection.
review_criteria.quote: Any paper where author identity is revealed in either the main text or the supplementary material will be desk rejected.

mandatory_policy.statement: Submissions must be double blind; revealed identity in text or supplementary material causes desk rejection.
mandatory_policy.quote: Any paper where author identity is revealed in either the main text or the supplementary material will be desk rejected.

mandatory_policy.statement: The main text must be at most nine pages at submission (ten during discussion and camera-ready).
mandatory_policy.quote: At the time of submission, the main text should be 9 pages or fewer.

mandatory_policy.statement: No author may appear as a co-author on more than 20 ICLR 2027 papers.
mandatory_policy.quote: No author may appear as a co-author on more than 20 papers.

mandatory_policy.statement: Authors on three or more papers must review at least six papers for ICLR 2027.
mandatory_policy.quote: All authors who are on 3 or more papers must serve as a reviewer for at least 6 papers.

mandatory_policy.statement: A dedicated AI use statement is required and does not count toward the page limit.

recommended_practice.statement: Authors are encouraged to include an ethics statement of at most one page, which does not count toward the page limit.
Authors are strongly encouraged to include a paragraph-long reproducibility statement.
Authors are encouraged to submit source code as supplementary material.
recommended_practice.quote: We encourage all authors to submit code as part of their submission.

compliance_checks.requirement: Main text is at most nine pages at submission.
No author-identifying information in text or supplementary material.
A separate AI use statement is present.
An optional ethics statement is present when relevant.
Author is within the 20-paper and one-unqualified-paper quotas.

changes_from_prior_year.change: ICLR 2027 states it has new policies this year on co-authorship, reciprocal reviewing, and the use of AI.
ICLR 2027 introduces submission quotas: at most 20 papers per author, and at most one paper per author with no eligible reciprocal reviewer.
ICLR 2027 requires an AI use statement in every submission.
ICLR 2027 publishes an expanded list of venues qualifying a reciprocal reviewer, determined as of the abstract deadline.
The binding detail of the 2027 AI policy is deferred to the separate AI Policy for Authors document, which is not one of this profile’s captured sources.
